# Chargers for many AA/AAA NiMH cells at once

**For the most cells: a 16-bay independent-slot charger.** The sources I found keep pointing to these:

- **Tenergy TN438 (16 bays):** My pick if you want visibility. It has an LCD showing each cell's status and protects against overcharge, overheating, short circuits and reverse polarity. It also has an 8-hour timer. It takes mixed AA/AAA NiMH/NiCd in any combination ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/)).
- **BONAI 16-bay:** Charges AA and AAA in any slot, with per-port LEDs. It runs on 110-240V AC at 250-500mA per port and can't charge alkaline or lithium cells ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-battery-chargers/)).
- **POWEROWL 16-bay:** 16 independent channels with a four-stage charge process (pre-charge, quick, floating, trickle) ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-battery-chargers/)).
- **CITYORK 16-bay:** Smart LCD with real-time status and heat-dissipation vents ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/)).

**For a smaller, cheaper setup: Tenergy TN480U (8 bays).** It has a per-slot LCD and charges at 500mA per AA and 250mA per AAA, with mixed sizes allowed. It runs from USB-C or Micro-USB (5V/2A). The listed price is $23.99 at Tenergy, verified 2026-10-21, with a 12-month warranty and 30-day returns ([Buy at Tenergy](https://dealectric.com/go/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger), an affiliate link; details on the [Dealectric page](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger)). It does not include a power adapter. On a 1A source, five or more AA cells drop to 250mA each, so use a 2A charger.

**What to look for:**
- Independent slots, so one bad cell doesn't hold up the others.
- Per-cell status (LCD or LED) and automatic shutoff.
- Remember that more bays at about 500mA each means the same per-cell charge time, but a bigger total power draw.

**Caveats:**
- The reviews I found are affiliate-supported roundups, not independent lab tests, so treat the rankings as a starting point.
- I don't have verified prices or direct buy links for the 16-bay models, so check current price, reviews and return policy on the seller's page before buying.
- The Tenergy price was accurate as of 2026-10-21 and may have changed.

If you tell me how many cells you typically charge and your budget, I can narrow it down.
